text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up: FinQuick is seeing elevated timeouts on /v1/generate on Hosted with spikes since 03:20 UTC. CS escalated; ticket #12345. They flagged 99th pct latency > 10s and SLO breach risk. Need eng owners + mitigation plan. cc @Liam Chen @Sofia Ortiz
Liam Chen: On it — eng-platform. Can you paste example request IDs + region? I'll start looking at autoscale logs and queue lengths.
Priya Rao: Request IDs: rq_aa12, rq_bb34, rq_cc56. Region: us-west-2. Mostly on model 'redwood-13b-instruct-quant' for longer sequences (>1024).
deploy-bot: ALERT: high-99th-latency detected · region=us-west-2 · model=redwood-13b-instruct-quant · triggered_at=2026-03-16T03:21:12Z
Sofia Ortiz: Checking node pool saturation vs queue. Marcus, can you validate whether any pods were cycled/evicted? tagging @eng-sre-oncall
Marcus Lee: No evictions showing. Queues spiked — looks like many requests queued and then large-batch execution created tail. Batching window currently 50ms for that route.
Liam Chen: If batching window is too high that can blow up tail for varied seq lengths. Can we temporarily lower batching_window_ms 50 -> 10 for the finquick route? Also consider max_batch_size down to 16. Rollback plan?
Sofia Ortiz: We can do a dynamic route override (no full deploy). Plan: canary override on pool-usw2-canary with batching_window_ms:10, max_batch_size:16. I'll run canary in ~5m, monitor 15m, then 45m full rollout if stable.
Priya Rao: Customer needs a timeline. Is this a config-only change? CS will notify FinQuick about a temporary change and potential rate-limiting if needed.
Marcus Lee: Confirm config-only. Applying canary to 2 canary nodes now. Will post dashboard link once metrics are live.
Marcus Lee: metrics: https://dash.reed/exp/finquick-latency?from=-30m
deploy-bot: Canary update applied by Marcus Lee — route override finquick -> pool-usw2-canary (batching_window_ms=10, max_batch_size=16)
Liam Chen: Observing improvements: 95th down to ~900ms, 99th down to ~2.2s within 6m of canary. Good signal. Root cause suspect: quantized model path + kernel selection hitting CPU fallback for some requests.
Sofia Ortiz: Opening tracking bug FI-2026 for kernel-selection + batching interplay. Assigning to eng-runtime for root cause and permanent fix.
Liam Chen: I'll triage FI-2026 and hand to runtime. Targeting a patch today (EOD) for kernel selection logic + a safer default batching profile for quantized paths.
Priya Rao: Thanks. I'll update FinQuick that we rolled a temporary config fix and engineering is targeting a permanent patch by EOD. Will escalate immediately if regression. :thumbsup:
eng-sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll monitor the canary and full rollout for 2 hours and escalate to infra if we see regressions.
Marcus Lee: Leaving metrics alerts on, will post if any error rate or 99th creeps back up.
Liam Chen: If anyone sees a regression ping me or open a P1 and tag eng-platform + eng-sre.
Priya Rao: Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone — CS will keep customer updated and close the loop once runtime patch is deployed.
